 ADISCORD_VAL_trade_routes_panel = { context_type = decision_category window_name = "ADISCORD_VAL_trade_routes_window" visible = { always = yes } triggers = {
  trade_occidia_map_visible = { VAL_trade_corridors_unlocked = yes }
  trade_occidia_1_label_visible = { VAL_trade_corridors_unlocked = yes NOT = { VAL_trade_route_occidia_open = yes } NOT = { has_country_flag = VAL_route_occidia_commissioned } }
  trade_occidia_2_label_visible = { VAL_trade_corridors_unlocked = yes VAL_trade_route_occidia_open = yes NOT = { AND = { check_variable = { var = VAL_black_market_pressure value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = VAL_corridor_security value = 3 compare = less_than } } } }
  trade_occidia_3_label_visible = { VAL_trade_corridors_unlocked = yes VAL_trade_route_occidia_open = yes check_variable = { var = VAL_black_market_pressure value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals } check_variable = { var = VAL_corridor_security value = 3 compare = less_than } }
